name: B P Capital Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, B P Capital Ltd was registered as a Non-Banking Financial Company[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
BPCL, formerly an NBFC, surrendered its RBI registration on 6th Oct 2016. A proposed merger with Diamond Footcare Udyog Pvt. Ltd. was later withdrawn, and NCLT dismissed the petition on 28th Aug 2019. The management is now exploring opportunities, including resuming NBFC activities, consumer goods trading, strategic partnerships, and developing a niche e-commerce platform.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.14 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -3.10% over last 3 years.
